WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amt"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__net_amt_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(CAST(orders.amount - COALESCE(customers.discount, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.net"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _cm_orders__net_amt_sum."orders.net",
  _base."orders.n",
  _base."orders.amt"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__net_amt_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_amt_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
LIMIT 21
